scripts.text:
[He Yuen Zhe]
Ni Hao!
Welcome to ^8B4513Kunlun^000000~
Take a walk around and experience
the ancient history and tradition
of our breath taking city.
scripts.translation:
[何远哲]
你好！
欢迎来到^8B4513昆仑^000000~
四处走走，领略这座壮丽城市的悠久历史与传统吧。

scripts.text:
[He Yuen Zhe]
I am responsible for helping you
with any questions you may have.
Please feel free to ask me anything.
scripts.translation:
[何远哲]
我负责为您答疑解惑，有什么问题尽管问。

scripts.text:
[He Yuen Zhe]
When you click on the ^B9062F[location name]^000000, you'll receive the most advanced ^B9062FNavigation^000000 services!
scripts.translation:
[何远哲]
点击^B9062F[地点名称]^000000，便可享受最先进的^B9062F导航^000000服务！
